name: Taste Skill
summary: Art direction and browser critique for websites and working app screens.
requires: Node 22+ and Chrome, Edge or Chromium for the inspection script
Network access for asset searches

name: Hallmark
summary: Theme-led design with explicit quality gates and redesign preservation.
requires: Node 18+ for static checks
Chrome and puppeteer-core for rendered checks
not_for: Design systems that are already locked
Rebuilding a working interface without a stated scope

name: UI/UX Pro Max
summary: Local searchable UX guidance, design tokens and stack-specific recommendations.
requires: Python 3
No model API for local search

name: Lucide
summary: One icon family with framework packages and tree-shakable imports.
requires: A package manager and the framework package for the project
not_for: Replacing an icon set the product already uses consistently

name: Morphicons
summary: Icon transitions that mark a real state change, with a reduced-motion policy.
requires: ESM and the matching framework peer
Explicit reducedMotion="user"

name: Kumo UI
summary: Cloudflare's React component system with semantic tokens for application interfaces.
requires: React 18 or 19 and React DOM
Phosphor icons as the peer icon set
Review of before-elements and left borders before adoption
not_for: A reason to migrate a working non-React stack

name: Humanizer
summary: Editorial pass that removes repetitive model prose without changing the facts.
requires: No runtime for the guidance
A real voice sample and audience for good results
not_for: Inventing experience or citations to sound human

name: SlopMonster
summary: Local pattern checker plus an optional independent model editing pass.
requires: Python 3 for the checker
A separate authenticated CLI for the optional pass

name: Ponytail
summary: The smallest complete change, with validation, security and tests kept intact.
requires: None for the rules
Node and host setup only if you enable the hooks
not_for: Cutting scope the user asked for
Skipping error handling to reduce line count

name: Spec Kit
summary: Turns multi-step features into specifications, plans, tasks and convergence checks.
requires: The specify CLI and an integration for your coding host
not_for: Projects you have not read yet

name: last30days
summary: Recent community evidence with source diagnostics and a dated synthesis.
requires: Python 3.12+
Node and source-specific access or credentials
not_for: Historical facts that need an authoritative record
Pretending a web search was an engine run

name: Scrapling
summary: Structured extraction with parsers, fetchers and bounded crawlers.
requires: Python 3.10+
Separate browser dependencies for JavaScript pages

name: browser-use
summary: Agent-driven browser work with visible actions, history and completion criteria.
requires: Python 3.11+
A configured model and browser
A dedicated test profile
not_for: Stable regression suites better served by deterministic tests
Any action the user has not authorised

name: REA
summary: Evidence-based inspection of shipped apps, packages and runtime behaviour.
requires: Node as declared by the release you install
Separate engines for native, managed and Android targets
not_for: Ordinary source review when the full source is available
